concept: A fractured, pixelated image of a ballot box shattering mid-fall, surrounded by fragments of military ordnance, frozen food packages melting into liquid, and silhouettes of distant marching troops, all rendered in sharp geometric shards against a darkening sky. The composition is split diagonally between order collapsing on one side and cold, systematic chaos on the other. Bold, high-contrast blacks and deep reds dominating. Style: hard-edged digital art with a sense of rapid disintegration.
explanation: Today's headlines paint a portrait of simultaneous institutional and physical collapse: democratic processes are contested (US votes, Australian social media ban debate), military violence escalates (Iran strikes, Ukraine bombing, Kherson fighting resuming), infrastructure fails (plane breakup, cyber-attacks on freezers), and criminal corruption ripples through government (Farmgate). Rather than depicting any single event, this image captures the layered, cascading nature of disorder—legal, military, technological, and moral—all happening at once across the globe.

headlines.title: US strikes Iran ahead of midterm elections
headlines.summary: US officials described the attacks on Qeshm Island as limited and defensive, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner.

headlines.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump's request to stop California counting disputed votes
headlines.summary: The ruling, which comes on the eve of the midterm elections, essentially ends the Trump administration's bid to disqualify the ballots in the state.

headlines.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
headlines.summary: Officials say at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a southern Ukrainian village in what the president called an "utterly horrific" attack.

headlines.title: Thousands of European troops to rehearse Ukraine deployment in event of peace
headlines.summary: Western officials stress that any force sent to Ukraine would not take part in any offensive operations.

headlines.title: Plane may have broken apart ahead of deadly Florida jet crash, say investigators
headlines.summary: The National Transportation Safety Board also believes weather could have been a factor in the crash, but warns it is too early to determine the cause.

headlines.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
headlines.summary: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

headlines.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
headlines.summary: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.

headlines.title: Legal challenge to Australia's social media ban to start in High Court
headlines.summary: A rights group will argue the world-leading policy robs under-16s of their right to free communication.

headlines.title: North Korea denies being behind record $6.3bn Binance hack
headlines.summary: US government agencies and cyber analysts have blamed Pyongyang for the record-breaking heist.

headlines.title: Man and boy arrested after allegedly attacking One Nation volunteer with bat
headlines.summary: The incident comes amid growing calls for the temperature of political debate in Australia to be turned down.

headlines.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president
headlines.summary: The case, part of the "Farmgate" scandal, has left President Cyril Ramaphosa mired in an impeachment saga.

headlines.title: Dutch police offer record €2m reward in hunt for drug lord
headlines.summary: Jos Leijdekkers has been found guilty in absentia of cocaine smuggling and is believed to be in Sierra Leone.
